name: caldav-calendar
description: CalDAV calendar integration — list calendars and events and create, update, or delete events on any CalDAV server (iCloud, Fastmail, Nextcloud, Google, and more) using an app password.
author: Buildersoft LLC

integration.description: Connect any CalDAV calendar server (iCloud, Fastmail, Nextcloud, Google) with an app-specific password.

fields.label: CalDAV URL
fields.helpText: Provider CalDAV endpoint (iCloud: https://caldav.icloud.com/, Fastmail: https://caldav.fastmail.com/, Nextcloud: https://<host>/remote.php/dav)

fields.label: App Password
fields.helpText: Use an app-specific password, not your account password

tools.name: caldav.list_calendars
tools.description: List the calendars available on the connected CalDAV account.

tools.name: caldav.list_events
tools.description: List events in a calendar within a time range.

calendar.description: Calendar name or URL (from caldav.list_calendars). Defaults to the first calendar.

start.description: Range start as an ISO 8601 date or datetime (e.g. 2026-07-01 or 2026-07-01T09:00:00). Defaults to now.

end.description: Range end as an ISO 8601 date or datetime. Defaults to 30 days after start.

tools.name: caldav.create_event
tools.description: Create a new event in a calendar.

calendar.description: Calendar name or URL. Defaults to the first calendar.

start.description: Start as an ISO 8601 date or datetime

end.description: End as an ISO 8601 date or datetime

allDay.description: Treat start/end as all-day dates (default false)

tools.name: caldav.update_event
tools.description: Update an existing event, located by its UID.

calendar.description: Calendar name or URL. Defaults to the first calendar.

uid.description: UID of the event to update

start.description: New start as an ISO 8601 date or datetime

end.description: New end as an ISO 8601 date or datetime

tools.name: caldav.delete_event
tools.description: Delete an event, located by its UID. This is not reversible.

calendar.description: Calendar name or URL. Defaults to the first calendar.

uid.description: UID of the event to delete
